findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 2, Harm 3
Raise: Not done
Case: normal use - A coordinator records another allowance for a prototype fix, then closes a README-only change. `forge fix allow-large` replaces the automatic prototype allowance (src/forge/task.py:712-713, 721-735), but the docs-only path still selects a light review and `review.run` uses the restricted prototype prompt (src/forge/review.py:861-863). After sign-off lands, this return still selects P0 solely because the change is docs-only, so the fingerprint remains valid and forge-pr-check accepts the pre-sign-off review. The new sign-off test covers only the automatic allowance (tests/test_prcheck_light_review_older_base.py:43).

stop.reason: The owner accepted: the hand-set allowance case stays a known issue

why: forge-pr-check can still call a clean light review out of date for a docs-only change that merged a newer default-branch commit with code changes, when the check's event base is older: prcheck passes the older event base to blocking_level (src/forge/review.py about 172, src/forge/docskip.py about 113), so the unrelated default-branch code counts in the docs-only classification and the light review looks no longer allowed. Part of client issue #1594, left by the owner's accept on 16 Nov 2026.
